title: Lean of the Mathematical Commons: Emmy Noether pilot
description:
A living, source-linked Lean 4 library and Mathlib coverage audit for classical mathematics, beginning with Emmy Noether. This release includes the pinned Lean/Mathlib project, promoted theorem modules, paper- and theorem-level coverage ledgers, controlled-witness provenance, bounded-memory build tooling, axiom audits, build receipts, limitations, Internet-source audits, and publication evidence.

Version 0.3.0 adds three late P22 modules for primitive selected-coefficient/product representatives, transition determinants, and finite determinantal ideals; a source-linked P40 module for the full-matrix and real-quaternion special cases of Noether's inner-automorphism theorem; and a P11 module for elementary-symmetric algebraic independence, the full symmetric invariant ring, and its abstract fraction-ring extension. The P40 adaptations retain exact Apache-2.0 attribution. A commit-pinned P11 Internet candidate supplied an API lead, but no unlicensed source bytes were copied. The verified graph has 55 direct Noether modules plus two umbrellas. Twenty-one of 43 works are partially audited; 154 of 343 inventoried units are completed or available, with 59 newly completed local rows.

The historical P22 determinant-norm/resultant identification, canonical forms, and later stages remain open. The full P40 arbitrary simple-subring theorem remains open. P11's arbitrary-subgroup fixed-field bridge, minimal-basis and parameterization theorem, singular locus, n-2 reduction, Castelnuovo step, and cyclotomic case remain open. Lean verification certifies only formal statements and explicit assumptions; it does not certify German transcription fidelity, translation, prose, layout, completeness, or critical-edition status. German canon authority remains separate from this repository.
